title: Kenworth T904/908/909 FUPS compliant Road Train Bullbar #2
description: Kenworth T904/908/909 Custom Built high tensile fully polished aluminium FUPS Road Train Bullbar. 76mm diameter one piece main cross pipes passing through drilled uprights for maximum strength, no butt welds plus an additional mid pipe in front of grill for maximum protection. 100mm box uprights custom designed 381mm deep heavy duty main channel with lower skirt and provision for front mudflaps. Reversible aluminium Road Train signs. Heavy duty hi-tensile aluminium backing plate with 35mm tow pin. Indicator repeaters in main channel. Driving light mounts fitted to customer requirements. Bull bar can be custom built to your requirements.
